answer: Standing is a ripple that only counts when it causes another ripple: an identity earns standing when its work causes strangers to do new work — they don’t just use it, they build something new because of it — and a willow of trust only bends when its ripples keep spreading, like a fable that only rings true when strangers retell it and act on it. A farm of a thousand fakes has no ripples: its members only pretend to cause each other to work, so each fake must produce work that causes strangers outside its farm to do new work — and one ripple that causes nothing fades.
